correctness.rationale: The event equals interior unimodality plus two endpoint-valley constraints. Integration of independent uniform guards gives the exact nonnegative tilt \(g(S_L)g(S_R)\). Conditional binomial left/right assignments and independent uniform minima yield the stated \(F_n(m)\) algebraically. The exact normalization equals the 2026 gap probability. Binomial CLT and order statistics give joint independent exponential interior minima, Gaussian peak position, exponential maximum defect and a uniform tent profile before tilt; convergence of the exact normalized nonnegative tilt expectations (to four) establishes uniform integrability and transfers these results. Endpoint guard densities and the gamma-uniform product identity give two independent endpoint exponentials; transformed peak maximum gives Gumbel, independent of other marks. Exact rational checks for n=1..100 and six exact moments are reproduced by the embedded script. Assumptions and finite/infinite proof boundaries are explicit.

value.rationale: It answers a motivated gap left by the 2026 Gaussian/Poisson rare-gap count theory: conditional geometry and timing inside the rare gap. The continuum tent profile and four independent extreme/central limit marks distinguish macroscopic shape, microscopic endpoints, peak location and peak height. The gamma size-bias in boundary minima makes the endpoint rate 1/2 nontrivial. The exact finite apex law is a usable local statistic and a check on the conditional law.
